title: By cell count, you are less than half human
caption: 30 trillion of your cells are yours. 38 trillion are bacteria, and together they weigh about 200 grams.
description: For a 70 kg reference adult the best estimate is about 30 trillion human cells and 38 trillion bacteria, a ratio near 1.3 to 1 and not the 10 to 1 once quoted. The estimates carry roughly 25% uncertainty, so the split is close to even. By count, about 84% of human cells are red blood cells; by mass, muscle and fat dominate.
sources: Sender, Fuchs & Milo, "Revised Estimates for the Number of Human and Bacteria Cells in the Body", PLoS Biology 14(8): e1002533 (2016), doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.1002533
